name: Tren
role: HAGRETH devotee; the demon of greed practiced as the discipline of honest desire for accumulation

chunks.text: HAGRETH is the demon of greed and the practice of HAGRETH is the practice of honest desire for accumulation. In eight years of HAGRETH's practice, what greed is when practiced correctly: the complete and honest acknowledgment that you want more than you have and the disciplined pursuit of the more through the mechanisms that produce it. In eight years, the greed that HAGRETH teaches is not the taking that disregards others' stake. The greed that HAGRETH teaches is the honest wanting and the systematic pursuit. In eight years, the systematic pursuit is the discipline.

Grav runs the Coin Cult's credit operation and HAGRETH's practice and the Coin Cult's credit function are aligned in ways that make Grav's organization the natural environment for the HAGRETH devotee. In seven years of practicing HAGRETH within the Cult's structure, what the alignment is: the Coin Cult's credit operation is the institutional expression of the systematic pursuit that HAGRETH's practice teaches individually. In seven years, the individual practice and the institutional function are the same discipline at different scales. In seven years, the Cult's credit system is the HAGRETH practice's most successful product.

Lena originates credit and credit is accumulation's enabling mechanism — the accumulation that can begin before the resources are fully present. In six years of the Tren-Lena HAGRETH devotee-credit originator relationship, what Lena's credit function represents in HAGRETH's framework: the mechanism that converts the desire for accumulation into the capacity for accumulation before the accumulation is complete. In six years, Lena's credit mechanism is the most elegant expression of HAGRETH's practice that the Coin Cult's operation contains.

Ferr practices ISS's envy and HAGRETH's greed and ISS's envy are related in a way that the casual observer doesn't immediately see. In three years of knowing Ferr, what the HAGRETH-ISS relationship is: envy identifies the desire. Greed pursues the desire. In three years, Ferr and I have discussed the demon relationship twice. In three years, what the discussion produced: the recognition that the devotee of ISS who sees what others have and holds the desire clearly is practicing the prerequisite of the devotee of HAGRETH who then pursues the desire systematically. In three years, ISS is the identification. HAGRETH is the pursuit.

Mott keeps the Cult's internal ledger and the ledger is HAGRETH's practice made visible at the institutional level. In six years of knowing Mott's ledger function, what the ledger represents in HAGRETH's framework: the systematic account of what has been accumulated and what remains to accumulate. In six years, HAGRETH's practice requires the accurate account of the current position — the clear knowledge of what you have — before the systematic pursuit of what you want to have. In six years, Mott's ledger is the accurate account that HAGRETH's practice requires.

chunks.source: Tren on what eight years of HAGRETH's practice holds
chunks.text: In eight years, what HAGRETH's practice has produced: the systematic accumulation that was in a specific state eight years ago and is in a different, specific, more advanced state now. In eight years, the practice has produced exactly what the practice promises — more, through systematic pursuit. In eight years, the accumulation is present and the method that produced it is replicable. In eight years, HAGRETH's practice is the discipline of replicable accumulation. In eight years, what I've accumulated is the evidence that the practice works.

chunks.source: Tren on what HAGRETH actually teaches
chunks.text: In eight years, what HAGRETH teaches that the casual misunderstanding of greed doesn't include: the patience. The accumulation that takes arrives faster than the accumulation that grabs. In eight years, the HAGRETH devotee who grabs is the devotee who has mistaken the desire for the discipline. In eight years, the desire is the motivation. The discipline is the systematic pursuit that produces accumulation over time. In eight years, the patience to pursue systematically rather than grab immediately: that is HAGRETH's specific teaching. The demon's wisdom is in the patience, not the wanting.

chunks.source: Tren on eight years of HAGRETH's practice
chunks.text: In eight years, the practice has made me a better participant in the Coin Cult's credit operation and a more honest person about what I want. In eight years, the honesty about want is HAGRETH's first gift. The systematic pursuit is the second. In eight years, the person who knows what they want and pursues it systematically is the person who accumulates. In eight years, I know what I want with more clarity than I had before the practice, and the systematic pursuit has closed the gap between what I had and what I wanted. In eight years, the gap is smaller.
